home.heading: Platform foundation
home.intro: The technical foundation is in place. Business modules are not yet implemented.

foundation.money: Money and percentage value objects with exact decimal arithmetic
foundation.schedule: Schedule date calculation with month-end clamping
foundation.errors: Single API error envelope and global exception handling
foundation.migrations: Flyway migrations with money and rate domains

system.heading: System status
system.unreachable: The backend is not reachable. Start it with: mvn spring-boot:run

login.heading: Sign in
login.intro: Your company key tells us which company's account to sign you into.
login.unreachable: The server is not reachable. Check your connection and try again.

inventory.heading: Inventory
inventory.intro: Units across every project. Sold and blocked units are hidden unless you ask for them.
inventory.priceInvalid: Enter an amount such as 2500000 or 2500000.00
inventory.loadFailed: The inventory could not be loaded.

holds.heading: Holds
holds.intro: Units held for a buyer. A hold keeps a unit off the market until it expires or is released.
holds.depositOptional: Optional. Leave empty if no deposit was taken.
holds.depositInvalid: Enter an amount such as 50000 or 50000.00
holds.placeFailed: The hold could not be placed.
holds.partyHint: A hold is for one customer or one lead.
holds.partiesUnavailable: Customers and leads could not be loaded.
holds.expiryNote: The hold expires after your company's standard period. You can extend it later.
holds.releaseExplain: The unit goes back on the market immediately. This is recorded against your name.
holds.loadFailed: Your holds could not be loaded.
holds.actionFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
holds.confirmHint: Confirming takes the unit off the market.
holds.confirmDenied: Only a manager or operations can confirm a hold.
